title: exoALMA. V. Gaseous Emission Surfaces and Temperature Structures
question: Where do 12CO J=3-2, 13CO J=3-2 and CS J=7-6 emit vertically in the 15 exoALMA disks, what 2-D (r-z) temperature structure and substructure do the surfaces and radial intensity profiles show, and how does emission height relate to disk properties such as disk mass

data.angular_resolution: 0.1'' requested; images used 0.15'' (fiducial) and 0.30'' (high surface brightness sensitivity, used for DM Tau)

what.value: Geometric parameters (M*, i, PA, vLSR, x0, y0) derived with DISCMINER

evidence.quote: We use geometric parameters (M$_{*}$, $i$, ${\rm PA}$, $v_{\rm LSR}$, x$_0$, y$_0$) derived from DISCMINER (see (cite: exoALMA_main; exoALMA_line_profiles)).

what.value: Continuum temperatures T_cont used as lower bound on T_mid

evidence.quote: The lower bounds of $T_{\rm mid}$ are set by the continuum temperatures $T_{\rm cont}$ derived in (cite: exoALMA_cont).

what.value: Continuum rings and gaps used for comparison with surface substructure

evidence.quote: We compare the emission surface substructure radial locations with the rings and gaps in the continuum reported by (cite: exoALMA_cont).

recipe.method: disksurf isovelocity-contour peak finding with iterative surface refinement; front surfaces only; J1604 and HD 135344B excluded
key_parameters: 5 iterations; maximum beamsize decreased from 2 beams to 1 beam; minimum SNR increased linearly from 1.0
Points binned by a quarter of a beamsize
assumptions: SNR per point is intensity divided by cube RMS; Keplerian rotation assumed by disksurf

recipe.method: Tapered power law z(r) fitted to the non-parametric points with disksurf MCMC, and independently via DISCMINER line-profile modelling
key_parameters: Free parameters z0, psi, r_taper, q_taper; best fit = 50th percentile, errors 16th/84th percentiles

recipe.method: Average of binned surface points, cutting points past the surface peak and interior to one beamsize

recipe.goal: Measure gas disk size R_edge and R_90
recipe.method: Cumulative integrated-intensity profile of 12CO normalised by its maximum; R_edge is the first peak; R95, R90, R68 from flux percentiles
key_parameters: No outer cutoff radius; hand-selected field of view covering all emission plus a few arcsec of noise

recipe.method: GoFish shifted-and-stacked radial profiles of integrated and peak intensity (full Planck function), plus brightness temperatures at each disksurf r-z point
key_parameters: Azimuthal bins of one quarter of the beam FWHM
assumptions: CO optically thick and in LTE so T_B equals gas temperature

recipe.method: Two-layer model with power-law atmosphere and midplane temperatures joined by a cos^2 profile up to height z_q; six free parameters fitted to the non-parametric surface temperatures
key_parameters: Points below 20 K discarded; all CS points excluded
Bounded priors on T_atm,0, T_mid,0, q_atm, q_mid, z0, beta (given in paper); T_mid bounded by continuum/CMB temperature below and irradiation temperature above
assumptions: Broad priors; fit convergence depended on them

recipe.goal: Identify substructure in surfaces and peak-intensity profiles
recipe.method: Savitzky-Golay smoothing and scipy find_peaks, with visual confirmation; compare locations with continuum rings/gaps and velocity-kink planet locations
key_parameters: Minimum width and separation at least the beamsize (0.15''), up to two beamsizes (0.3''); prominence scaled to the beamsize or larger (surfaces), 7 to 15 K (peak intensity)

recipe.goal: Correlate <z/r> with stellar and disk properties
recipe.method: Spearman and Pearson coefficients; linmix linear fit to R_edge; emcee linear fits to disk mass and surface density
key_parameters: emcee linear fits with 100 walkers and 5000 iterations
assumptions: Priors keep the model above zero; errors propagated from <z/r> and M_disk

recipe.goal: Benchmark disksurf against DISCMINER on MCFOST cubes
recipe.method: Both codes applied to simulated 30 and 60 degree inclined disks in 12CO and 13CO and compared with the tau = 2/3 surface

score_reason: Data and derived products are public and most fitting settings (emcee walkers, SNR clips, smoothing, peak-finding) are given with numeric results, but calibration/imaging, DISCMINER geometry, per-disk masks and some priors are deferred or unstated.
rediscovery_reason: Public exoALMA data and VADP, an explicit surface and temperature recipe, and numeric results (mean <z/r>, T_atm, T_mid, correlations) allow an approximate redo, though per-disk visual masking limits exactness.
